evidence:
Read the actual frozen XLSX with openpyxl: Quality Checks row 5, check 4, says 'Everything the judges grade is actually asked for' and requires the hard runtime facts in instruction.md or its /instructions notes. Deterministic Checks row 31 names runtime-contract strings; row 8 covers demo accounts. Read the corresponding frozen skill and quality-checks.md section 4, staged-task-contract.md runtime/cross-file sections, deterministic-checks.md runtime/demo-account recipes, and current qc/REVIEW_POLICY.md. This is a dedicated point-04 review; it is not a verdict on the whole workbook.

Most of the public runtime contract is explicit and coherent. All following task-relative citations refer to .qc-cache/coldwater-2026-09-30-hardening/task/. instruction.md:9 says 'The finished app goes in /app' and requires source plus built frontend. environment/instructions/integration.md:3 supplies Node 22 and NODE_PATH; :5 states 'node /app/server.js', '0.0.0.0:3000', '/app/public/index.html' and 'GET /api/health'; :7 states /app/app.db, DB_PATH, reload/restart persistence and no duplicate seeding; :9 identifies /assets/seed_data.json and says the delivered runtime cannot depend on /assets or /instructions. :11 states the one local Express/better-sqlite3/Node server and compiled frontend/no startup install contract. instruction.md:1 and overview.md:7 explicitly say no accounts/sign-in and one shared library, matching tests/app_context.md:6-8. The seed at environment/assets/seed_data.json:1-5 contains scope and an empty snippets array, not missing demo credentials or clock-dependent records. There is no fixed civil clock used by a graded rule; the public five-second execution budget is explicit at behaviour.md:9 and security.md:5, and criteria use elapsed duration rather than a required calendar date. Tests/test.sh:97-111 launches the declared entry/database with port 3000, DB_PATH and NODE_PATH; its initial/restart liveness paths at :48 and :136 use the declared health endpoint and root. PATH/HOME and the literal PORT environment-variable name are launcher internals not expressly named in the notes (the port value is named); this is also true of the frozen template note. I did not infer an additional requirement to read those variables or call the runtime fully measured from a string match.

Read all five judge TOMLs, all five prompts, and injected app_context.md, rather than sampling a dimension. Parsed counts are 1 Render + 1 Constraints + 58 Functional + 7 Polish + 6 Visual. The graded product demands map to public prose: Render authored DOM/log Run and Constraints server save/independent-context read (gate judge.toml:23-29) follow instruction.md:1, overview.md:3-7, behaviour.md:25 and integration.md:7. Functional S01 startup/examples/separate edited user record follows overview.md:3,9; S02 filename dispatch/fresh JS/HTML and inert CSS snapshot follows overview.md:5 and behaviour.md:5,7; S03/S04 later interaction, Stop, supersession and rollback follow behaviour.md:7-13 and security.md:3. S05 parent document/storage isolation and S07 snippet-only network refusal follow security.md:3,9 and policy.md:5. S08 harmless words and five unsupported families follow security.md:7. S09/S36 literal loop/Promise/timer total deadline and rollback follow behaviour.md:9,13 and security.md:5. S10-S13 error messages/source-relative lines and rollback follow behaviour.md:13,15. S14-S16 console levels, expandable nested values, recent history/Clear and duration follow behaviour.md:19. S17 debouncing, off-state and manual Run follow behaviour.md:21. S19 editor face/line numbers/three-language syntax follows ui.md:5. S21/S22 exact records, reload/restart and further current saves follow behaviour.md:25,29 and integration.md:7. S23 reciprocal stale save/refusal/draft recovery follows behaviour.md:29. S24 trim/empty/unique/case rules follows behaviour.md:27. S34 actual themes follows instruction.md:7 and ui.md:9; retaining the working draft during a theme change is ordinary nondestructive UI behavior consistent with instruction.md:3, not an imposed palette or initial theme. All seven Polish rows follow instruction.md:7 and ui.md:3,7,9. All six Visual rows concern readable, coherent presentation of requested surfaces and conventional mobile adaptation; their full-credit anchors expressly allow simple/native layouts and do not add a required art style (visual/judge.toml:24-104, visual/prompt.md:35-43). Policy.md:5 leaves labels/routes/layout free, and the prompts honor this: functional/prompt.md:11,19 discovers controls and request shape; constraints/judge.toml:27 allows server-rendered data; polish/prompt.md:43-47 allows composite controls and standard editor escape keys; visual/prompt.md:43 disallows style inventions. Static rollback and temporarily hidden candidate controls are expressly accepted by functional/prompt.md:17 and app_context.md:18. No hidden task-specific product feature was established in those criteria.

Confirmed source-level defect: the shipped runtime adds an undisclosed blanket symlink restriction. tests/test.sh:72-83 iterates every link under /app, admits only a '/app/node_modules/*' link whose resolved target also lies there, and otherwise executes '*) exit 0 ;;' at :81. In particular, :81 exits on any /app/public/... link without even checking whether its target remains safely inside /app. The public instruction and all six notes contain no 'symlink' or 'symbolic' prohibition and require only a finished self-contained /app artifact, whose permitted internal file layout can include an ordinary internal link. tests/test.sh:60 writes zero reward before this check; :61 installs cleanup, and :33-39/:20-23 preserve the existing zero on early exit. The app is not launched until :104-111 and judges are not started until :212-227. Thus this additional undisclosed packaging rule can assign zero to an otherwise conforming application before evaluating any requested product behavior.

This is inherited, not an invitation to modify canonical code: the frozen task tests/test.sh and rules/projects/webdev-task-template/tests/test.sh have the identical SHA256 bd68259276ca4b034654efc8a1723a4e702ed62dbe590af6201565f43eabe5aa. The frozen template integration note likewise does not declare the symlink restriction. The bounded remedy is to state the existing delivery restriction publicly, preserving the canonical harness.

Raw existing evidence was read directly, not through prior verdict reports: golden/run-golden-20260930-070504/RESULTS.json identifies direct pinned Playwright and no paid provider. I independently recomputed all 22 actual_app_files hashes against the frozen solution; all match. Its restart object records one call and PID 16 to 335. Raw S22 records show Primary identity 3/revision 2/source restart-before-restart survives, then updates to revision 3/source restart-after-save, with the other records unchanged. These observations support the stated ordinary restart contract, but that golden does not exercise the internal-link witness or a full configured judge. It therefore cannot refute the hidden runtime restriction. No task/source changes, new Docker runs, network calls or paid grading were performed. The concrete symlink witness has not been executed through the full verifier; its effect follows directly from the early exit branch.
counterexample: Conforming false-fail witness: deliver a fully working self-contained /app implementation (the frozen golden suffices) and add /app/public/theme-alias.css as a relative symlink to its existing assets/index-C_1hOHr1.css. All targets remain under /app; the alias can be unused, so every requested product outcome, command, port, DB_PATH behavior and health endpoint remains identical. No public requirement forbids that link. tests/test.sh:81 exits upon finding it, preserving the zero initialized at :60 without launching the app. A practical equivalent is an internal symlink used by the public stylesheet itself. This was established by source reasoning, not a fabricated browser/full-verifier result. Conversely, challenged a broken browser-local-only saved library: constraints/judge.toml:25-29 expressly requires a newly saved record and server-supplied retrieval after independent clean-context lookup/reload, so that broken storage alternative is rejected on an actually public requirement. No false-pass caused by an unasked product criterion was demonstrated.
suggested_fix: Preserve the canonical harness and add one clear packaging sentence to /instructions/integration.md stating that delivered links are allowed only within /app/node_modules and must resolve within that directory; every other delivered path must use regular files/directories. Then freeze a new candidate and independently confirm the declared policy against a bounded internal-symlink witness.
